resources.string: Includes the exact bytes of files you select: photos, videos and documents. Albums, stacks, memories, people, preferences and private-vault contents are not included. This is not a complete library backup.
Choose storage on this device or a connected USB drive. No network service is used by Lightforge. Keep the backup until you have checked your restored files.
Cancelled. Files created by this operation were removed.
Cleanup was incomplete. Check the selected destination for an incomplete backup or a Lightforge-restored folder before trying again.
Operation failed. Check available space, access and backup integrity, then try again. Existing originals were not changed.
Backup integrity verified. Review before restoring.
Backup saved and destination bytes verified.
Restored files were reopened and their SHA-256 hashes verified.
Choose at most 10,000 files per backup.
Restore copies into a new Lightforge-restored folder. Existing files are not overwritten or deleted. Organization and preferences will not be changed.
Cancel the operation and remove only the files it created? Leaving this screen or restarting the app interrupts the operation.
A previous operation was interrupted. Check the selected destination for an incomplete backup or Lightforge-restored folder. No automatic cleanup or completion is assumed after an app restart.

Back up the exact bytes of selected photos, videos and documents. Optionally include organization linked to those files. The review lists partial collections and unresolved people. Private-vault content is excluded. This is not a complete library backup.
This backup contains organization. Gallery restore is unavailable here; restoring to a folder copies originals only.
Linked originals: %1$d / %2$d · omitted references: %3$d · unresolved identities: %4$d
%1$d global rules may affect the existing library. They stay off unless you explicitly opt in.
Preferences and automatic archive rules are recorded for review only. Existing settings will not be overwritten or enabled.
Create new copies in Gallery and new organization. Existing files and decisions stay unchanged. Duplicate bytes remain separate files. Unresolved people are not matched to existing identities.
Also import reviewed global rules affecting the existing library
Gallery copies and reviewed organization restored.
Restore the reviewed partial selection, including incomplete collections
Copies or journals retained for review: %1$d. They changed or their ownership is uncertain; nothing else will be deleted automatically.
Recovery did not finish. Existing copies were preserved when their status could not be verified.
